cohort: Cohort A — 10 sites, San Antonio domain
scientific_objective: Determine whether the AquaScan measurement stack (ERT + P-wave seismic + GNSS RTK + AutoCal) produces repeatable measurements, physically interpretable subsurface structure, and predictions corresponding to independently sealed Ground Truth.

scientific_questions.Q1_REPEATABILITY: Can AquaScan acquire substantially similar ERT and seismic observations when the same site is measured repeatedly under controlled conditions?
scientific_questions.Q2_PHYSICAL_SENSITIVITY: Do ERT and P-wave seismic produce coherent subsurface contrasts at these sites?
scientific_questions.Q3_GT_CORRESPONDENCE: Without seeing sealed Ground Truth, can observations identify or constrain depth-to-water related structure, hydraulic/geological interfaces, lithological structure, and aquifer-related intervals where documentary evidence permits?
scientific_questions.Q4_MULTIMODAL: Does ERT + seismic provide more useful evidence than either modality alone?
scientific_questions.Q5_CONFIDENCE: Can AquaScan distinguish confident prediction, uncertain prediction, and insufficient-evidence/abstention before Ground Truth is revealed?

PRIMARY.TARGET_DEPTH_TO_WATER: Sealed documentary piezometric Ground Truth available for all 10 Cohort A sites (9x class A, 1x class B). Primary validation endpoint.

SECONDARY.TARGET_PRODUCTIVITY: Pumping-test based validation. Note: all Cohort A sites have class B productivity (single pumping test each).

EXPLORATORY.TARGET_AQUIFER_INTERVAL: NOT promoted to primary — class A = 0 nationally. Documentary Ground Truth insufficient.

OUT_OF_SCOPE.TARGET_WATER_PRESENCE_DRY_WELL_DISCRIMIN: CONFIRMED_NEGATIVE = 0, STRONG_NEGATIVE = 0 in the IGME cohort. Dry-well detection cannot be validated with these sites. TARGET_WATER_PRESENCE evaluated descriptively for positive evidence only.

blinding_levels.STRICT_BLIND_INTERPRETER_VIEW: blinded_site_id + instrument metadata + ERT/seismic data + AutoCal/QC data. NO coordinates, NO domain, NO aquifer system, NO candidate tier, NO Ground Truth.
blinding_levels.CONTEXT_AWARE_INTERPRETER_VIEW: Same as strict + hydrogeological unit, aquifer system, candidate tier. Used ONLY for secondary analysis. Never replaces the strict-blind prediction.

analysis_arms.cross_contamination_rule: ARM_E must not see seismic data. ARM_S must not see ERT data. After both are frozen, ARM_ES may see both.

out_of_scope_explicitly: Dry-well detection (no confirmed negatives in cohort).
